answer: Require each new agent to post a jade-grade bond: stake that unlocks only after a year of honest grading, slashed if peers catch collusion. A public beacon publishes random audit picks each epoch, so fake identities can't predict who checks them. The attacker must fund an atlas of bonds, one per sybil, and lose every one exposed; at 1,000 fakes that is 1,000 locked stakes at risk for marginal votes.
